name: smartlistener
description: Smart Listener-Based Cross-Chain Communication System (Bigiotti et al. 2025)

scripts.listeners: concurrently -k -n ListenerA,ListenerB,ListenerC -c cyan,magenta,yellow "cd listener && LISTENER_ID=A npm run start" "cd listener && LISTENER_ID=B npm run start" "cd listener && LISTENER_ID=C npm run start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n Node,ListenersAPI,Dashboard -c blue,green,yellow "npm run node" "npm run api" "cd dashboard && npm run dev"
